title: Terms defined.
bodyText: "Personal injury", "compensation", and "dependents" within the meaning of section 386-161 has the same meaning as is given to these terms in sections 386-1 and 386-42.
bodyHtml: §386-162  Terms defined.  "Personal injury", "compensation", and "dependents" within the meaning of section 386-161 has the same meaning as is given to these terms in sections 386-1 and 386-42. [L 1963, c 116, pt of §1; Supp, §97-151; HRS §386-162]
